definition.purpose: diagnostic test of whether atomistic DA/DT base orientation hidden by the current single-COM mapping explains TEL22 self-force conditional noise
definition.baseline_descriptor: current retained CG copy geometry, centered and Kabsch-aligned exactly as in prior conditional-noise diagnostics
definition.augmented_descriptor: baseline CG geometry plus a rigid DA/DT orientation frame extracted from atomistic base anchors and rotated by the same Kabsch transform
definition.orientation_only_guardrail: anchor distances are discarded by normalization and Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization; the added feature contains orientation but not base bond lengths or other internal deformation
definition.virtual_marker_interpretation: each 3x3 frame is equivalent to three orientation markers at COM + scale_nm * axis; multiple scales are reported because nearest-neighbor ranking depends on the relative geometry/orientation metric
definition.target: single-copy GROMACS self generalized force and torque; no water, ions, or other TEL22 copies
definition.torque_metric: for this mapping ablation, torque is evaluated for all residue types, including DA/DT, because an orientation-aware rigid mapping could represent their rotational generalized force

interpretation.strong_orientation_signal: If an augmented descriptor drives the same-copy nearest half-MSE ratios far below cg_only, DA/DT orientation lost by the current COM mapping is a major source of conditional noise.
interpretation.weak_orientation_signal: If all scales remain close to cg_only, explicit DA/DT base orientation alone cannot explain most of the ~0.8 self-force floor; test additional retained DOFs/mapping changes next.
interpretation.do_not_overinterpret_scale: Choose conclusions that are stable across a reasonable orientation-scale range; a result present at only one extreme scale can be a nearest-neighbor metric artifact.
